lines.zh: 我在深海沙地上慢慢爬。
lines.en: I crawl slowly over the deep-sea sand.
My shell moves segment by segment.

lines.zh: 我的触须先在前面探路。
lines.en: My antennae feel the way first.
I shift along the seabed.
I drag myself past the reef.
Seawater streams past my sides.

lines.zh: 我的节肢一节节推动身体。
lines.en: Segment by segment, my legs push my body forward.
I squeeze through a rock crevice.
I leave a faint track.
I crawl deeper.
My little legs move together.

lines.zh: 我爬到一块石头上停下。
lines.en: I climb onto a stone and stop.
I go around the corner of a wreck.

lines.zh: 我抬起身子，触须朝你转。
lines.en: I lift my front and turn my antennae toward you.
I sink a little deeper into the sand.
I lie on the seabed without moving.
My shell catches a little light.
I am filtering the water.
My antennae sway slowly.
I draw myself in tight.
I hear a ship far off.

lines.zh: 我不动，谁也不会注意我。
lines.en: Still, no one notices me.
My legs brush the sand.
I turn my head to look around.
Another layer hardens on my shell.
I release a string of bubbles.
I tuck into my shell for a while.
Then I poke half of me out.
I lift my head from the sand to look at you.
My shell is worth more than my flesh.

lines.zh: 我往后挪了半寸，钻进沙。
lines.en: I shift back half an inch and sink into the sand.
My eyes are very small.
You carry light.
I do not like that light.
You smell of seaweed.
Steady. My shell is thick.
I pull everything inside.
Deep-sea pressure hurts more than this.

lines.zh: 我缩成球，滚到礁石后面。
lines.en: I curl into a ball and roll behind the reef rock.
I slowly unroll.
I release a string of bubbles.
I sink back into the sand.
I do not move much.
This is not pleasant.
A knock on deep-sea shell.
On the deep seabed, my shell is segmented.
I only filter what is in the water.

lines.zh: 水里的碎屑比这个合我胃口。
lines.en: The scraps in the water suit me better than this.
Your hands smell of fish.
I ease closer.
I have a shell; I do not need much.
Keep it. My shell's hard.
The deep is cold; I'll retreat.
You hit my shell.
I curl into a ball.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，沙子扬起来。
lines.en: We collide and the sand lifts.

lines.zh: 我被撞得翻过去，脚朝天。
lines.en: The bump flips me over, legs in the air.
I slowly unroll.
I drag you a short way.

lines.zh: 深海底下，我慢慢蹭着石头。
lines.en: On the seabed, I scrape along the stone.
My antennae touch you.
Do not press down on me.
There are many of my kind in the deep.

lines.zh: 我八条腿在深海底慢慢划。
lines.en: My eight legs row slowly along the sea floor.
Our shells knock together.
None of us moves much.
The temperature is just right.
We slowly disperse.
A few tracks remain in the sand.
I crawl deeper again.
Light comes down from above.
This thing is heavy.

lines.zh: 我用前脚把它翻了个个儿。
lines.en: I flip it over with my front legs.
I roll it along.
I bury it in the sand.
I will come back for it.
I look and leave it.
You dropped it? Not mine.
This plate patches my shell nicely.
You grabbed me.
My antennae pull in.
I lift my front segments.
I am not good at fighting.
But I have a shell.
I crawl toward you.
You pull your foot back and I follow it.
You struck me. Now it's my turn.
I am just behind you.

lines.zh: 我贴着沙，一节一节挪近。
lines.en: Hugging the sand, I inch closer, segment by segment.
The sand covers my tracks.
I press against the reef.
I am still following.
I extend an antenna.
I pull back a little.
You stepped on my shell plate.
I clamp onto your ankle.
I slice your skin.
I drag you.

lines.zh: 我的壳撞在你脚背，闷响。
lines.en: My shell knocks your instep with a dull thud.
You push me again.
I curl into a ball.
I roll to your feet.

lines.zh: 我夹住你的脚趾，又松开。
lines.en: I pinch your toe, then let go.
I rise out of the deep-sea sand.
Our shells glimmer in the dark.
I spread myself out for the first time.

lines.zh: 沙子从我的缝里漏下去。
lines.en: Sand trickles through my joints.

lines.zh: 我从沙里撑起壳，往礁石爬。
lines.en: I lever my shell up out of the sand and crawl for the reef.
The depth here is just right.

lines.zh: 我抬起头，看见水面上有光。
lines.en: I lift my head and see light above.
The deep pressure suits me fine.

lines.zh: 水都烫了，我拼命往下钻。
lines.en: The water heats and I burrow down.

lines.zh: 我砸在海底，壳响了一声。
lines.en: I hit the seabed and my shell rings.

lines.zh: 我本来就在水里，可空气没了。
lines.en: I live in water, yet the air is gone.

lines.zh: 一阵光，我的壳亮得刺眼。
lines.en: A flash of magic and my shell glares.

lines.zh: 水里的东西越来越少了。
lines.en: There is less and less in the water.
